rows.label: tlk70000067_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Ever since Mirei came, the inn feels
like it suddenly brightened up.

rows.label: tlk70000067_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I keep finding myself about to say,
"If only things had been like this..."
but...

rows.label: tlk70000067_04_msg0003
rows.name:
But time to put the past behind
me and look to the future.

rows.label: tlk70000067_04_msg0004
rows.name:
There may be some inconveniences, but
from now on, Mirei and I plan to live
here quietly together.
